programs.description: Katniss volunteers to replace her sister in a tournament that ends only when one participant remains. Pitted against contestants who have trained for this all their life, she has little to rely on.
Imprisoned at the International Space Station, a group of terrorists manages to escape confinement and take control of the ship. However, their mission to target the Soviets threatens world peace.
